Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 124. Category: technique. Rank 1.

Rank 1 melee technique
Ki Cost: 6 ki
Casting Time: 1 bonus action
Range: melee
Chargeable?: No
Duration: Instantaneous
Roll a combo attack roll, dealing your unarmed strike
+ 2d6 damage. On a successful hit the target must make
a strength saving throw or be knocked prone.
If you use this technique after a melee technique you
gain advantage on this technique’s combo attack roll.
